# Review: Policies table (range `58edfdebc...HEAD`)

This review covers only the committed range you gave (7 commits, `58edfdebc` → `9659919e6`). I only read code: no files changed, no tests run, nothing posted.

**Scope:** 34 files, +1,619 −177. The diff starts from `1a3adcc`, the common ancestor with `58edfdebc`. About 1,136 of the changed lines are source; the rest are tests, stories and fixtures.

**Repo rules:** these come from `AGENTS.md` and `apps/web/AGENTS.md` (web app, Vitest, verify/tsc/eslint/prettier checks). Three bear on this diff: keep comments to one line and only for what the code can't say, never use `any`, and write UI text in sentence case.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Verdict** | Fix the must-fix below before opening the PR |
| **Score** | about 76/100. Checked by two agents each: 3 of 9 findings, all three confirmed |
| **Held down by** | Rows for the same policy on the same Safe get merged, which hides status differences and pending edits |
| **Fix first** | Finding 1: `PoliciesTable/index.tsx:27` |

## Scores by area, worst first
| Area | Score | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Bugs | 55 | 1 must-fix, 2 should-fix, 1 minor |
| Testing | 75 | No test for the merge edge cases; the search hook has no test file |
| Conventions | 80 | Several multi-line comment blocks, against the one-line rule |
| KISS | 90 | Unused analytics field left behind, and an orphan comment |
| DRY | 90 | The load-error component copies `TransactionDetailsError` |
| Architecture | 92 | A hook imports a helper from a component file |
| Regression | 92 | Catalogue analytics lost the "Is Available" field |
| Security | 100 | Nothing found. No auth, signing or data fetching in the diff |
| Performance | 100 | Nothing found. Work is bounded by the number of policies in a space |

## What this review did not cover
- **Not fully run as specified:** I ran the nine area checks myself instead of one agent per area. Only findings 1–3 went through the validate/refute agent pairs. The other six have **not been checked by a second agent**, but they still count fully toward the score.
- **Not live yet:** `Policies/Page.tsx:12` still renders `<Policies />` with no props. So in production the table, loading and error states can't be reached yet. Only the catalogue changes ship (the Account recovery tile is removed, the grid is now 3 columns, the tile is now a button).
- Nothing was run: no tests, type-check, lint, Storybook or screen reader.

## Must fix before opening

**1. Rows merge policies whose status or data differ, and pending edits disappear** (bugs · P1 · confirmed by both agents · confidence 80)
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/Policies/PoliciesTable/index.tsx:27` (duplicate key at `:82`)
- **What:** `toRows` groups rows on `type:address:proposer` only. The row keeps the first policy's status, tokens and summary. Every other match just adds its `chainId`, even when it's the same chain.
- **Effect:**
  - A policy that is active on mainnet but not enforced on Polygon shows as **Active**. That is exactly the case the `getPolicyStatus` comment says must never read as active.
  - An active spending limit plus its pending update on the same Safe and chain become one row. The pending state is hidden, and `chainId` is pushed twice, which gives duplicate React keys and a duplicate icon.
  - `supersedesId` (`types.ts:111`) is never read anywhere.
- **Proof:** the `LongList` story (`PoliciesList.stories.tsx:55`, `mockLongPolicyList(30)`) collapses to 3 rows, each with 10 copies of the same `chainId`. So it never paginates (page size is 25), even though its comment says it does.
- **Fix:**
  - Only merge rows whose status and data match, or show each chain's status on the row.
  - Remove duplicate chain IDs.
  - Handle `supersedesId` explicitly.
  - Add tests for mixed status across chains and for an active and a pending policy on the same chain.

## Worth fixing, or a ticket
| # | Area · priority | Where | Finding |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | Bugs · P2 · confirmed | `Policies/PoliciesList.tsx:48`, `hooks/usePolicySearch.ts:35`, `PoliciesTable/components/PoliciesTableStates.tsx:11` | The placeholder and empty-state text promise search "by name, address or network". Policies have no names, and `chainId` is collected but not in the Fuse `keys`, with no chain names indexed. Typing "Polygon" returns "No policies found". Either index network names or change the text. |
| 3 | Bugs / accessibility · P2 · confirmed | `Policies/PoliciesTable/index.tsx:116` | The row `aria-label` is `Open ${policy.type} policy details`. It reads the raw ID ("spending-limit") and is the same for every row of a type. Because it replaces the row's content as its accessible name (`PaginatedDataTable/index.tsx:261`), a screen-reader user can't tell apart two Safes' spending limits. Use `getPolicyLabel` plus the Safe address and network. |
| 4 | Testing · P2 | `hooks/usePolicySearch.ts:1` | No unit tests. Search by address, token and summary, and the 0.2 fuzzy threshold, are only covered by one test through `PoliciesList`. |
| 5 | Accessibility · P3 | `components/common/PaginatedDataTable/index.tsx:259` | A `role="button"` row now contains other interactive elements: the copy and explorer buttons from `EthHashInfo`, and the mobile toggle. That breaks the nested-interactive rule. Mouse clicks are handled, since `CopyTooltip` and `ExplorerButton` stop propagation and the toggle got `stopPropagation`. |
| 6 | Bugs · P3 | `Policies/utils/policyLabel.ts:50` | `formatDays` rounds, so a review window under 12 hours shows "0 days review window". |
| 7 | Conventions · P3 | `types.ts:1,10,136` · `index.tsx:27` · `PoliciesLoadState/index.tsx:27` · `PoliciesTable/index.tsx:37` · `policyLabel.ts:10,57` · `PoliciesList.tsx:20` | Multi-line and multi-paragraph comment blocks, against the `AGENTS.md` rule to keep comments to one line. |
| 8 | KISS · P3 | `hooks/usePolicySearch.ts:7` · `services/analytics/mixpanel-events.ts:161` | The file-level doc comment isn't attached to anything. `MixpanelEventParams.IS_AVAILABLE` is now unused, and catalogue click events no longer send it, so check any Mixpanel dashboard that uses it. |
| 9 | DRY / architecture · P3 | `PoliciesLoadState/index.tsx:8,32` · `hooks/usePolicySearch.ts:4` | `POLICIES_LOAD_ERROR` repeats the `TX_DETAILS_LOAD_ERROR` text, and `PoliciesLoadError` copies the structure of `TransactionDetailsError`. Separately, the hook imports `getPolicyTokens` from a component file; it belongs in `utils/`. |

## Worth tidying (no score impact)
- Move `getPolicyTokens` into `utils/`, next to `policyLabel` and `policySort`.
- Remove `MixpanelEventParams.IS_AVAILABLE`.
- Point the `LongList` fixture at distinct Safes or policy types so it actually paginates.

## Ruled out
- **Copy button opening the row:** `CopyTooltip` calls `stopPropagation` (`components/common/CopyTooltip/index.tsx:27`), and so does the explorer button.
- **Stale page after a search:** `PaginatedDataTable` goes back to page 1 when the row keys change.

## How this was produced
The scope was the diff from the common ancestor to the head commit. I read every source hunk in full and grepped the code around it. Two independent agents (one confirming, one trying to refute) checked findings 1–3; none were refuted. Nothing was written, run or posted.
